2609.24657.title: Circuit Hypernetworks for Quantum-Augmented Diffusion Language Models
2609.24657.paper_summary: Language models can be adapted by changing the computations applied to individual tokens. Quantum circuits offer one such approach, but evaluating wider circuits inside a large model can be computationally demanding. Here we introduce HyperQ, which adds token-conditioned quantum residual branches to a frozen masked-diffusion language model. A quantum residual branch is a module in each transformer block that reads a token's hidden state, emits the coordinates of that token's circuit, executes it, and adds the measured values back through a residual connection. The backbone remains frozen, and only the added branches are trained. Within each branch, a lightweight circuit hypernetwork emits token-specific rotation angles, coupling strengths, and measurement axes in a shared sparse circuit structure. The required expectation values have an exact classical expression whose evaluation cost grows linearly with the qubit count, enabling circuits from 16 to 64 qubits to be trained within a 1.1-billion-parameter backbone. Across downstream benchmarks, increasing circuit width raises the average score from 47.65 to 54.30. At 64 qubits, HyperQ exceeds the backbone and its low-rank-adapted counterpart by 4.71 and 3.67 points, respectively. HyperQ is fine-tuned on 20,000 prompt-response pairs, compared with 200,000 for the classical baselines. These findings support token-conditioned circuit emission as a tractable architectural approach to quantum-augmented language modelling.
2609.24657.paper_summary_zh: 語言模型可以通過改變應用於單個標記的計算來進行調整。量子電路提供了一種這樣的方法，但在大型模型中評估更廣泛的電路可能會在計算上要求很高。在這裡，我們介紹了HyperQ，它將標記條件的量子殘差分支添加到一個凍結的掩蔽擴散語言模型中。量子殘差分支是每個Transformer塊中的一個模塊，它讀取標記的隱藏狀態，發出該標記電路的坐標，執行它，並通過殘差連接將測量值添加回來。主幹保持凍結，只有添加的分支被訓練。在每個分支內，一個輕量級電路超網絡發出標記特定的旋轉角度、耦合強度和測量軸，這些都在一個共享的稀疏電路結構中。所需的期望值有一個精確的經典表達式，其評估成本隨著量子比特數量的增加而線性增長，使得從16到64個量子比特的電路可以在一個11億參數的主幹中進行訓練。在下游基準測試中，增加電路寬度將平均分數從47.65提高到54.30。在64個量子比特時，HyperQ超過了主幹及其低秩適應對應物，分別提高了4.71和3.67分。HyperQ在20,000個提示-響應對上進行微調，而經典基準則使用200,000個。這些發現支持標記條件的電路發射作為一種可行的架構方法，用於量子增強的語言建模。
